notes.title: Mods Have Arrived!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce the arrival of Felt Tip Circus mods - now ANYONE can create custom acts and post them to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/427890/workshop/]Workshop[/url] for all to play.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12062400/5409725e67209c06881fab5586800e67f5ef6abb.png[/img]

Our first new act [b]Whack-A-Bear[/b] is already available - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=707501049]check it out here![/url]

If there's an act you'd like to see from us or from the community, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/427890/discussions/1/]don't hesitate to post a request![/url] And if you've got ideas for an act of your own, check out our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=679909700]modding guide[/url] to learn where to download our template project, tools & free asset pack.

Happy modding!

notes.title: Felt Tip Circus -- Released!
notes.content:
Step right up, good sirs and madams, and enter the most virtual of realities!

Throw a hail of deadly implements whilst leaving innocent bystanders unharmed. Launch critters this way and that with the power of your good right arm. Tame savage beasts and become their master. Balance your life upon the thinnest of wires and let the balls fall where they may. Hone your artistry alone or destroy your friends by superior skill in a grand contest of up to 4 players!

There is no other spectacle quite like this one. Get in the spotlight and give them hell!
